# Janine Isaacs

> An independent perspective. Janine Isaacs offers a confidential hour to people who are making an important personal decision inside a legal or financial process: succession and inheritance, the sale or handover of a business, ageing parents, family estates, divorce and separation. Former medical negligence solicitor (twelve years, latterly partner, Legal 500 and Chambers recognised firms), then twenty years in FCA-regulated businesses and property investment and development. In person in London, Manchester and Miami; elsewhere by arrangement.

What it is: a confidential hour with someone independent, who understands the process the client is in and has no interest in the outcome beyond theirs. Clearer ground before the next meeting, the next letter, the next conversation.

What it is not: not legal advice, not therapy, not mediation, and not a message carried between parties. She does not sit in negotiations or speak to the other side. Advisers advise; she works with the person receiving the advice.

For professionals: solicitors and advisers can introduce a client discreetly, and she is happy to speak to the professional first. She does not advise on law, comment on strategy, or contact the other side.

Contact: hello@janineisaacs.com, +44 7747 897113
